arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace

# Test replace method with various kwargs
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print('Original:', v)
print('replace(major=5):', v.replace(major=5))
print('replace(minor=7):', v.replace(minor=7))
print('replace(patch=9):', v.replace(patch=9))
print('replace(prerelease=\"beta\"):', v.replace(prerelease='beta'))
print('replace(build=\"new\"):', v.replace(build='new'))
print('replace(major=0, minor=0, patch=0):', v.replace(major=0, minor=0, patch=0))

# Test module-level replace function
print()
print('Module replace(\"1.2.3\", minor=5):', replace('1.2.3', minor=5))
print('Module replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", major=2):', replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', major=2))
"
